response.overview: Simon is a jaded office worker whose life seems to be going nowhere. He is repeatedly passed over for promotion, he is bullied by the sleazy office alpha, and he has unrequited feelings for his beautiful colleague, Jen. Then one day, Simon stumbles across a mysterious self-help tape and becomes captivated by the strange and enigmatic voice which promises life-changing benefits and rewards. All he needs to do is listen to the tapes and follow the Higher Path. Simon soon commits to the Higher Path and receives the full set of tapes from a mysterious cult of men. His life begins to change dramatically: he beats his alpha male colleague to a promotion and gets the girl of his dreams… but at what cost? Dark visions start to plague Simon’s mind, and strange men begin to stalk him. Simon soon discovers that the voice on his tapes may have an agenda of its own.
response.title: The Higher Path
